claims: Rory McIlroy filed for divorce from his wife Erica Stoll in May 2024 after seven years of marriage.
Rory McIlroy officially voluntarily dismissed the divorce petition in June 2024.
The dismissal confirms that Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll had reconciled.
McIlroy stated that over the weeks following the filing they realized their "best future was as a family together" and resolved their differences.
As of April 2026 Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll are together.
As of April 2026 Erica Stoll has been present at tournaments supporting Rory McIlroy.
Erica Stoll was present at the 2026 Masters supporting Rory McIlroy.
Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll married in 2017.
Rory McIlroy and Erica Stoll have one daughter Poppy Kennedy
